name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SaaS Customer Support & Client Success | Small-Business Software, Troubleshooting & Clear Documentation
summary: Customer-facing SaaS professional who has spent years helping small service businesses get value from software: answering how-to questions, fixing setup and access problems, and walking less technical owners through it by phone. Retained all but one of 15-20 partners at Birdeye and onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix. Documents every interaction so the next person can pick it up cold, and uses AI assistants daily to research faster and write clearer notes and guides.
